name: ncm-k8s-collector
description: NKP OpenTelemetry collector stack (cluster-collector Deployment + node-collector DaemonSet) deployed to workspace clusters and configured by the ncm-k8s-collector-operator.
overview:
# Telemetry Collector

The `nkp-otel` collector stack: a cluster-collector (Deployment) and a
node-collector (DaemonSet) that gather Kubernetes metrics, logs, and object
snapshots and export them to one or more backends.
